# Protocol Contract Checklist: Per-Region Retail Prices on Cost Responses

**Purpose**: Check that the requirements for `RegionPrice` and `region_prices` are complete, unambiguous, and
safe for the wire contract, before and during PR review
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and
requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]`
only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does
not mean implementation work is complete.

## Wire Compatibility and Held Fields

- [ ] CHK001 Are the field numbers for both responses fixed, and are the held numbers (16 and 6) named with the
  issue that will use them? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Is it stated whether the held fields are held by comment or by a protocol reservation, and is that
  consistent with issue 588 later using them? [Clarity, research.md R1]
- [ ] CHK003 Are mixed-version outcomes stated for both directions (old host and new plugin, new host and old
  plugin)? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2]

## Advisory and No-Sum Semantics

- [ ] CHK004 Is "advisory" defined precisely: never summed, never compared, never required to match the primary
  cost? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK005 Is "same basis as the parent" defined for both the projected cost and the estimate response, which name
  their primary fields differently? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the meaning of an empty list stated, and kept distinct from "a region priced at zero"? [Clarity,
  Spec §FR-004, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK007 Is it stated whether the requested region may also appear in the list? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Row Validation Rules

- [ ] CHK008 Are all rejected row conditions enumerated, with the field each error names? [Completeness, Spec
  §FR-006, FR-007, FR-008]
- [ ] CHK009 Are the rules the spec adds beyond the issue (negative prices, ISO 4217 currency) recorded as
  assumptions with a rationale? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the decision not to reject duplicate regions recorded, along with what plugins should do instead?
  [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the dry-run rule defined for projected cost, and stated as not applicable to the estimate response?
  [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, research.md R5]

## Non-Functional

- [ ] CHK012 Is "no measurable cost" on the zero-allocation path stated with an objective comparison method?
  [Measurability, Spec §FR-016, SC-004]

## SDK and Conformance Parity

- [ ] CHK013 Is it required that plugin self-validation and the conformance suite apply the same row rules?
  [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, FR-012]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the Go SDK options' copy semantics specified (whether caller rows are copied or aliased)? [Gap,
  research.md R6]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the reference mock plugin's behaviors for both responses and for dry run specified? [Completeness,
  Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK016 Is TypeScript coverage defined beyond regenerated types? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and
  `/speckit-clarify`
